description: This file contains unit tests for the MainActivityBase class in the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing UI behavior and flow logic related to add-on installation status and user interactions.

classes.name: MainActivityBaseTest
classes.description: Test class for MainActivityBase, containing tests for UI display and flow logic.

classes.name: TestMainActivity
